overview: This broadcast of the Mustang Report features a trivia answer, an interview about an upcoming fundraiser for pediatric cancer, and various student classroom video clips.

items.title: Question of the Week Answer
items.summary: The broadcast opens with the answer to the previous week's trivia question about a balloon ride in Australia.

items.title: Buzz Off for Kids with Cancer Interview
items.summary: Victoria Rasche interviews McGlynn Middle School teacher Anthony Petrelis about Team Medford's participation in the Buzz Off for Kids with Cancer fundraiser at Gillette Stadium.

items.title: History Exhibition Presentation
items.summary: A clip features a presentation discussing John F. Kennedy's presidential legacy and public memory.

items.title: Mock Congressional Debate
items.summary: Students participate in a simulated legislative session debating trade and national security.

items.title: Student Musical Performance
items.summary: Students sing a graduation song about moving forward while holding onto memories.
